instruction:
Farm Shop and Greenhouse Link Drawing Set and Room Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.txt, result.ifc, result.pdf. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited room schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 6 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 24 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 2 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: SHOP, PREP, STORE, OFFICE, WC, GREENHOUSE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [16.0, 8.0, 3.92].
9. result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: RoomNumber, RoomName, Area.
10. result.txt has exactly 6 data rows in this order: F01 SHOP 25.0, F02 PREP 9.0, F03 STORE 6.0, F04 OFFICE 9.0, F05 WC 4.0, F06 GREENHOUSE 48.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, FLOOR PLAN, SECTION, FARM SHOP AND GREENHOUSE LINK, SHOP, GREENHOUSE, PREP.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
